tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Paper, a warm off-white. Dark: near-black slate.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs, the order panel.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Stone. Customer chat bubbles and inset areas. Ink text only.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows. Too faint for control borders, on purpose.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders on inputs and secondary buttons. 3.4:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Slate. Main text, and the colour of the wordmark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Timestamps, help text, captions. Not for anything the seller has to act on.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Main buttons and Revaro's chat bubble. Slate on light, stone on dark: the brand is mostly ink.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of primary buttons.

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Links and active tab labels.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary.

tokens.name: brand-dot
tokens.usage: Terracotta. The full stop in the logo. Use as a small mark only: the active tab indicator, the morning count, the logo. Never a state.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Terracotta for text, when a word needs the brand colour. Passes 4.5:1 on paper and white.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring. Blue so it's never confused with terracotta or slate.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Confirmed, paid, sold.

tokens.name: success-fg
tokens.usage: Text on success-bg.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Waiting on the seller: payment to check, needs you, low stock. Yellow-amber, kept away from terracotta.

tokens.name: warning-fg
tokens.usage: Text on warning-bg.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Something is wrong: sold out, paid but no stock, failed to send.

tokens.name: danger-fg
tokens.usage: Text on danger-bg. A cool crimson, so it never reads as the brand terracotta.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Reject payment, cancel order. Always behind a confirm step.

tokens.name: on-danger-solid
tokens.usage: Text on danger-solid.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: In progress, nothing to do yet: held, drafting, waiting for details.

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: Text on info-bg.

tokens.name: bubble-customer
tokens.usage: Customer messages.

tokens.name: bubble-revaro
tokens.usage: Revaro's automatic replies.

tokens.name: on-bubble-revaro
tokens.usage: Text in Revaro's bubble.

tokens.name: bubble-seller
tokens.usage: The seller's own replies. A terracotta tint so they never look like Revaro's.

tokens.name: on-bubble-seller
tokens.usage: Text in the seller's bubble.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dimmed layer behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one big number on a screen, like the morning count.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Receipt received. Check KPay before you confirm.
styles.usage: Everything else in English. 16px is the floor for inputs; smaller and iPhones zoom in.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Times and channel names. If the seller needs to act on it, it's not a caption.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Prices and counts, tabular so totals line up.

styles.name: body-my
styles.sample: အနက်ရောင် M ကို ၂ နာရီ သိမ်းထားပေးပါမယ်။
styles.usage: Burmese body text. Pyidaungsu where the phone has it, Padauk otherwise. 1.75 line height so stacked marks don't clip in either.

styles.name: heading-my
styles.sample: မှာယူမှု အတည်ပြုရန်

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; between chat bubbles.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside badges and compact rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and phone side margins.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards in the queue.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of the morning summary.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges and stock pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tabs, counts, the usage bar.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards. Barely there; the border does the work.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The sticky action bar at the bottom of the phone screen.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: tap-comfort
tokens.usage: Primary actions on phones (Confirm order, Take over).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum reading width of the dashboard on tablets and desktops.

tokens.name: bubble-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a chat bubble within its column.
